I did not find a clean source showing Srettha pressuring the Election Commission, censoring media, or directing security forces for partisan entrenchment. Available evidence is mostly indirect: populist spending, a restrictive broader political environment, and court action against both Srettha and the opposition.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand pledges to uphold democracy and human rights at Summit for Democracy","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-03-20","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/summit-for-democracy-statement-2024?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c3060006848","summary":"Srettha publicly aligned his government with democracy, rule of law, and human rights.
